home.why_speed_body: Extensive experience across varied BI projects means you reach expected outcomes faster and more reliably than with a generalist team.
home.why_customer_body: At Vitray, our clients' success isn't just a goal — it's our core value. Your growth and achievements are directly tied to ours.

home.testimonials_body: Real experiences from businesses that have grown with our solutions.

home.maturity_title: With You From Awareness to Data-Driven
home.maturity_body: The journey to data-driven decision-making is gradual and purposeful. At Vitray, our approach is designed around the data maturity model — mapping the path from initial awareness to fully data-driven decision-making.
home.stage1_body: Data is collected manually from multiple sources. The focus is on building initial understanding of data's value and standardizing reports.
home.stage2_body: The organization uses a centralized platform for reporting and regularly monitors its key performance indicators.
home.stage3_body: Data becomes the primary source of key decisions, with analytics playing a decisive role in organizational direction.
home.stage4_body: Data is embedded in every process and decision across the organization — no decision is made without it.

about.hero_body: Vitray was founded in 2019 with one goal: help organizations transform raw data into actionable insight. Our team brings together technology and business specialists who deliver innovative BI solutions.
about.what_title: Business Intelligence That Works for You
about.what_body1: Using advanced tools like Microsoft Power BI and other analytics technologies, we transform your data into visual reports and dashboards — enabling faster, more accurate, data-driven decisions.
about.what_body2: We focus on empowering organizations to thrive in competitive markets, delivering tailored solutions for every industry's unique requirements.
about.what_body3: Vitray's ultimate goal is to drive digital transformation and strengthen data-driven innovation across organizations.
about.story_title: Vitray: the Art of Breathing Life into Glass
about.story_body: At Vitray, we bring that same artistic spirit to your data — transforming it into clear, meaningful visuals that make decisions easier and the future more legible.
about.maturity_title: With You from Data Awareness to Data-Driven
about.maturity_body: Becoming data-driven is a deliberate, step-by-step journey. At Vitray, our approach is built on the Data Maturity Model — a framework that maps an organization's path from first awareness all the way to fully data-driven decision-making.
about.maturity_closing: Throughout this journey, Vitray acts as your trusted advisor — from identifying your organization's current position on the maturity model, to designing the technical and analytical solutions that match your future goals.

pulse.feat1_body: Share Power BI reports with managers, teams, and clients in a secure and controlled manner.
pulse.feat2_body: Filters and date ranges using the Jalali calendar — fully aligned with Iranian business needs.
pulse.feat3_body: A native, smooth experience for Persian-speaking users, with no training or complex setup required.
pulse.feat4_body: Precise control over who can access which report — based on role, team, or project.
pulse.about_title: Manage and Share Power BI Reports
pulse.about_body: Pulse is a centralized portal for managing and sharing Power BI reports. Users can view, filter, and share reports — with a fully Persian interface, Jalali calendar, and granular access control.
pulse.arch_title: Independent Software on Power BI Report Server
pulse.arch_body: Pulse runs as an independent layer on top of Power BI Report Server — without any changes to PBRS code or configuration. Your BI infrastructure remains untouched; Pulse only uses its official API.
pulse.update_body: Because Pulse operates independently from PBRS, you can upgrade your Power BI Report Server at any time without affecting Pulse — and vice versa.
pulse.closing_body: A demo and more complete information will be available soon

daana.feat1_body: Build agents with their own instructions, personality, and model of choice — grounded in your organization's knowledge, fully versioned with one-click rollback.
daana.feat2_body: Ask questions of your enterprise data models in plain language; Daana compiles them into safe, validated queries.
daana.feat3_body: Recording, Persian transcription, and automatic summaries — with speaker mapping, decisions, and action items.
daana.feat4_body: Daana extracts people, topics, and decisions from your meetings and content, and connects them together.
daana.demo_title: Ask Your Data, In Your Own Words
daana.demo_body: No SQL, no complex tooling — just ask. Daana connects securely to your enterprise data sources, answers with citations, and every user only ever sees the data they are authorized for.
daana.demo_q1: How did autumn quarter sales compare to summer?
daana.demo_a1: Autumn sales grew 18% over summer; the largest contribution came from the distribution channel, up 27%.
daana.demo_q2: What was decided in yesterday's meeting with the sales team?
daana.demo_a2: Three decisions were recorded: revising the Azar targets, launching the B2B campaign, and a follow-up session on Azar 20.
daana.cap_title: Everything Your Organization Needs for AI
daana.cap_body: Instead of scattered tools, one governed workspace — knowledge, agents, automation, and cost control, together.
daana.cap1_body: Versioned, shareable building blocks that extend what agents can do — with an internal organization-wide marketplace.
daana.cap2_body: Agents answer from your own notes, files, and meetings — with citations back to the source.
daana.cap3_body: Connect to SQL databases, MCP servers, and internal content — always read-only and secure.
daana.cap4_body: Scheduled agents, event triggers, and multi-step processes with human-in-the-loop approval.
daana.cap5_body: A Persian-first block editor with structured databases, templates, and granular permissions; files are indexed automatically.
daana.cap6_body: Semantic and full-text search across notes, files, meetings, and agents — fully permission-aware.
daana.cap7_body: A coordinator agent fans work out to specialist agents — with full execution traces.
daana.cap8_body: Agents generate interactive HTML dashboards and reports — re-runnable, shareable, exportable.
daana.about_body: Daana is a multi-tenant SaaS platform: every organization gets its own fully isolated tenant — users, data, AI configuration, and billing. The entire experience is designed RTL-first, every date is Jalali, and you can run on cloud models or models hosted on your own infrastructure.
daana.sec_body: Full tenant isolation, multi-factor authentication (authenticator apps, passkeys, recovery codes), LDAP/Active Directory integration, AES-256 encryption for all credentials, and comprehensive audit logging — in Daana, security is architecture, not an add-on.
daana.cost_body: Quotas are checked before every AI call; per-user and per-agent spending caps, usage reporting by user, agent, model, and task type, ROI analytics, and even per-conversation cost — all transparent and exportable.
daana.closing_body: Contact us for a demo and more details

plex.cap1_body: Build professional enterprise applications without a development team or programming knowledge.
plex.cap2_body: From external databases and APIs to CSV and the built-in database — everything with one click.
plex.cap3_body: Dozens of ready-made components and professional templates for fast and easy UI design.
plex.cap4_body: Eliminate manual and repetitive processes and build workflows that make your entire organization smarter.
plex.convert_title: Turn Data into an App — in Just One Click
plex.convert_body: Build powerful apps, forms, and workflows in seconds — without writing a single line of code. Plex is built for teams who want to build faster, spend less, and deliver professional digital solutions.
plex.access_body: Access control is the cornerstone of every enterprise system. Plex provides granular, level-by-level access management — from the entire system down to the most detailed field — ensuring full data security and control in all scenarios.
plex.workflow_body: Workflow is the heart of business process automation. By combining Triggers and Actions, Plex enables automated and intelligent execution of all kinds of processes — from data updates and notifications to condition validation and approval workflows.
plex.datasources_title: Connect to Any Data Source — or Build Your Own Database
plex.datasources_body: Connect to an external database, pull data from an API, import CSV files, or start fresh with Plex's built-in database.

pixel.cap3_body: No heavy implementation costs — just a transparent, predictable monthly subscription.

pixel.viz_body: Pixel dashboards are interactive, visual, and fully customizable. Filter, drill down, and extract real insights from your data — no technical knowledge required.

bi.hero_body: From needs discovery to operational dashboards, the Vitray team is with you at every stage of BI implementation — turning your data into real insights.
bi.sources_body: Our BI solution connects to all your organization's systems and data sources to give you a unified view of your business.
bi.access_body: No longer tied to the office or one device. Vitray BI dashboards display correctly on any screen — from the executive's phone to the analyst's laptop. All you need is a browser.
bi.pill_anywhere: Access from Anywhere in the World
bi.process_body: Our structured approach ensures every project phase is executed with full quality and transparency.
bi.phase1_body: We run discovery workshops with your team to truly understand business requirements. Key performance indicators and core decision-making questions are identified and documented.
bi.phase2_body: We collect data from diverse sources — ERP systems, databases, Excel files, and external APIs. Data cleansing and validation are performed to ensure quality.
bi.phase3_body: We design data structures and models that enable more accurate and faster analysis. Star schema and snowflake modeling are used to optimize queries.
bi.phase4_body: We transform integrated data into interactive dashboards and reports. Visuals designed for every organizational level, from senior executives to operational analysts.
bi.phase5_body: We stay by your side after launch. We analyze new needs, integrate additional data, and maintain system performance over time.
bi.pillars_title: The Pillars of Our BI Solution
bi.pillars_body: Every BI project rests on six core principles that together form a comprehensive and sustainable solution.
bi.pillar_integration_body: Connect to diverse data sources and manage both structured and unstructured data in a single unified platform.
bi.pillar_analytics_body: Transform raw data into actionable insights through modeling, forecasting, and real-time reporting.
bi.pillar_infra_body: Solutions that grow with your business while ensuring data security and regulatory compliance.
bi.pillar_ux_body: Intuitive dashboards that require no deep technical knowledge. Better decision-making for everyone in the organization.
bi.pillar_improvement_body: Continuous optimization of the solution as business needs evolve, with dedicated technical support.
bi.pillar_reporting_body: A complete view of organizational performance at strategic, tactical, and operational levels in one unified platform.
bi.source_erp_content: Direct connection to ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, and local systems to extract financial, production, and supply chain data.
bi.source_crm_content: Integration with customer relationship management platforms to analyze sales, customer behavior, and revenue forecasting.
bi.source_plex_content: Native connection to Vitray Plex platform to integrate production, quality control, and factory operations data.
bi.source_excel_content: Automatically import and refresh Excel files and manual reports without re-entering data.
bi.source_csv_content: Support for CSV, TSV, and other structured text formats for periodic or one-time data imports.
bi.source_sqldb_content: Connect to relational databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB via optimized connectors.
bi.source_oracledb_content: Oracle database integration for large enterprises with high data volumes and enterprise-level security requirements.
bi.deliverables_body: At the end of every project, a complete package of documentation, dashboards, and technical knowledge is handed over to your team so they can operate the system independently.
bi.templates_body: Dedicated dashboard templates for various industries, fully customizable to your business needs.
bi.closing_title: Business Intelligence: An Investment with Real Returns

b2b_sales.hero_body: Vitray's B2B Sales Dashboard puts real-time pipeline, rep performance, and enterprise client behavior at your fingertips — so every sales decision is backed by evidence, not gut feel.
b2b_sales.caps_title: What the B2B Sales Dashboard Gives You
b2b_sales.caps_body: Three core pillars that set Vitray's sales dashboard apart for enterprise sales teams.
b2b_sales.cap1_title: Connects to Every Sales Data Source
b2b_sales.cap1_body: ERP, CRM, Excel files, and even custom APIs — all your sales data flows into one unified place, giving you a complete view of the business with no blind spots.
b2b_sales.cap2_body: From the CEO's phone to a sales rep's laptop, the dashboard renders correctly on every device — with role-based access so each person sees exactly the data they should.
b2b_sales.cap3_body: Your org structure, sales cycle, and KPIs aren't the same as anyone else's. The B2B Sales Dashboard is designed and customized around your sales model — not a generic template.
b2b_sales.views_title: Six Angles on Your Sales Pipeline
b2b_sales.views_body: Every page in the dashboard answers a specific business question — from executive overview down to operational detail, all one click away.
b2b_sales.view1_body: A single page for senior leadership: sales status, target attainment, and year-over-year comparison — all in one view, no separate reports needed.
b2b_sales.view2_body: Dynamic root-cause analysis on sales swings; segment by brand, customer group, product line, and rep to find the real reason behind growth or drop.
b2b_sales.view3_body: A cross-tab of products and reps; see which rep sells which product to which enterprise client, and surface the buying patterns of your key accounts.
b2b_sales.view4_body: Place any two time periods side by side — month over month, quarter over quarter, or pre- and post-campaign — and measure the actual impact of your decisions.
b2b_sales.view5_body: Macro trends across the organization, annual and monthly, on multiple dimensions — so you spot shifts in customer or market behavior before they hit revenue.
b2b_sales.view6_body: Flexible share-of-sales analysis across multiple classification levels; from product category down to SKU, and from region down to individual key accounts.
b2b_sales.kpis_title: What the B2B Sales Dashboard Measures
b2b_sales.kpis_body: A set of metrics that — in Vitray's enterprise sales projects — have proven to drive the most impact on sales-leadership decisions. All fully customizable to your business model.
b2b_sales.stack_title: Built on a Professional Data Stack
b2b_sales.stack_body: Data is extracted and cleansed from your sources with SSIS, modeled in an independent Semantic Layer on SSAS Tabular, and finally turned into a fast, polished Power BI dashboard — an architecture that keeps your data model intact even if you change the visualization tool later.
b2b_sales.demo_body: A real Power BI sample built by the Vitray team — filter, drill down, and explore the data yourself right now.

dist_sales.hero_body: The distribution business has challenges of its own — customer coverage, rep performance, product returns. Vitray's Distribution Sales Dashboard turns those challenges into solvable problems with real-time, decision-ready data.
dist_sales.caps_title: What the Distribution Dashboard Gives You
dist_sales.caps_body: Three core pillars that set Vitray's distribution dashboard apart for distribution companies.
dist_sales.cap1_body: From distribution and warehouse software to CRM, Excel, and field-rep APIs — all your branch and channel data flows into one unified place.
dist_sales.cap2_body: Regional manager on mobile, sales supervisor on tablet, CEO on laptop — everyone sees one version of the truth, with role- and region-based access control.
dist_sales.cap3_body: Your branch structure, customer grading, and product mix are unique. The dashboard is designed around your distribution model — not a generic template.
dist_sales.views_body: Every page in the dashboard answers a specific distribution question — from daily branch status to market-coverage analysis.
dist_sales.view1_body: Daily sales detail compared to last month, last year, and the matching period — all on one management page, no separate reports required.
dist_sales.view2_body: Daily sales per branch vs. target and historical average; quickly spot the top performers and the branches that need intervention.
dist_sales.view3_body: A cross-tab of product, sales rep, and customer; see which rep sells which SKU to which customer grade, and surface real buying patterns.
dist_sales.view4_body: New-product penetration rate, shelf presence, and active-customer retention — the metrics that matter most in distribution, in one place.
dist_sales.view5_body: Examine returned products to find the priorities for improving sales and distribution processes — the cost that often hides in plain sight.
dist_sales.view6_body: Visual performance assessment of sales regions on a map; quickly spot weak regions, expansion opportunities, and regional patterns.
dist_sales.kpis_body: Metrics that — in Vitray's distribution projects — have proven to drive the most impact on sales and operations decisions. All fully customizable.
dist_sales.stack_title: Built on a Professional Data Stack
dist_sales.stack_body: Branch and channel data is extracted with SSIS, modeled in an independent Semantic Layer on SSAS Tabular, and finally turned into a fast, polished Power BI dashboard.
dist_sales.demo_body: A real Power BI sample built by the Vitray team — filter, drill down, and explore the data yourself right now.

finance_dash.hero_body: From revenue trends and expense control to liquidity and upcoming checks — Vitray's Finance Dashboard gives you a full, no-blind-spot picture of your organization's financial health.
finance_dash.caps_title: What the Finance Dashboard Gives You
finance_dash.caps_body: Three core pillars that set Vitray's finance dashboard apart for CFOs and senior leadership.
finance_dash.cap1_body: It doesn't matter which accounting software or ERP you use — your financial data is extracted, unified, and presented in one consolidated view.
finance_dash.cap2_body: CFO, CEO, and shareholders each see only their permitted data — on any device — with role-based access control and full encryption.
finance_dash.cap3_title: Built Around Your Chart of Accounts
finance_dash.cap3_body: Your account hierarchy, cost centers, and finance structure aren't the same as anyone else's. The dashboard is designed around your chart of accounts and finance workflows.
finance_dash.views_body: From revenue analysis and margins to liquidity and AR aging — every financial question has a dedicated view.
finance_dash.view1_body: Monthly revenue trend compared against prior years; immediately spot deviations and identify the real drivers of growth or decline.
finance_dash.view2_body: Macro trends of income and expense KPIs across monthly, quarterly, and annual ranges — catch shifts early, before they hit annual profit.
finance_dash.view3_body: Surface excess or unusual costs to improve profitability; manage OPEX proactively instead of reacting to year-end statements.
finance_dash.view4_body: Activity in every account with drill-down to individual transactions; full clarity on where money comes in and where it goes.
finance_dash.view5_body: Real-time view of receivables, in-transit checks, bank balances, and upcoming checks — a complete picture of the company's cash position.
finance_dash.view6_body: Categorizes overdue receivables by due-date bucket; an essential tool for improving collections and reducing receivables risk.
finance_dash.kpis_body: Metrics that — in Vitray's finance projects — have proven to drive the most impact on finance leadership decisions. All fully customizable.
finance_dash.stack_title: Built on a Professional Data Stack
finance_dash.stack_body: Financial data is extracted with SSIS from your accounting system and ERP, modeled in an independent Semantic Layer on SSAS Tabular, and finally turned into a fast, trustworthy Power BI dashboard.
finance_dash.demo_body: A real Power BI sample built by the Vitray team — filter, drill down, and explore the data yourself right now.

hr_dash.hero_body: From attendance and overtime to training and performance — Vitray's HR Dashboard helps you see the hidden patterns in your people data and make faster, evidence-based decisions.
hr_dash.caps_title: What the HR Dashboard Gives You
hr_dash.caps_body: Three core pillars that set Vitray's HR dashboard apart for HR leaders and senior management.
hr_dash.cap1_body: From attendance and payroll software to LMS systems and Excel files — all your HR data flows into one unified place.
hr_dash.cap2_body: HR data is sensitive. Each manager sees only their unit's data, with precise role-based access control and full respect for confidentiality.
hr_dash.cap3_body: Your reporting lines, cost centers, and HR metrics are unique. The dashboard is designed around your real org chart and HR workflows.
hr_dash.views_title: Six Angles on Your Human Capital
hr_dash.views_body: From the macro picture of headcount to deep performance and training analysis — every HR question has a dedicated view.
hr_dash.view1_body: Workforce composition, age, gender, and education distribution on one page; a complete picture of human capital for senior leadership.
hr_dash.view2_body: Absence rate, lateness, and leave usage at the unit and individual level; spot absence patterns before they hurt productivity.
hr_dash.view3_body: Average overtime by unit and person; identify people under pressure and units that genuinely need additional headcount.
hr_dash.view4_body: Training hours per employee, mandatory-course pass rates, and a unit-level competency map — to build teams ready for what's next.
hr_dash.view5_body: Performance review results across periods, with unit-by-unit and person-by-person comparison; the evidence behind promotion and bonus decisions.
hr_dash.view6_body: Attrition rate, exit reasons, and time-to-fill for open roles; an essential tool for cutting the hidden cost of turnover.
hr_dash.kpis_body: Metrics that — in Vitray's HR projects — have proven to drive the most impact on HR leadership decisions. All fully customizable.
hr_dash.stack_title: Built on a Professional Data Stack
hr_dash.stack_body: Your HR data is extracted with SSIS from attendance, payroll, and training systems, modeled in an independent Semantic Layer on SSAS Tabular, and finally turned into a fast, secure Power BI dashboard.
hr_dash.demo_body: A real Power BI sample built by the Vitray team — filter, drill down, and explore the data yourself right now.

production_dash.hero_body: From machine performance and scrap rates to unplanned downtime — Vitray's Production Dashboard puts real-time line data into the hands of plant managers and operations leaders.
production_dash.caps_title: What the Production Dashboard Gives You
production_dash.caps_body: Three core pillars that set Vitray's production dashboard apart for plant and operations leadership.
production_dash.cap1_body: From MES and shop-floor PLCs to ERP and operator log files — all your shift and line data flows into one unified place.
production_dash.cap2_body: From the shift supervisor's monitor at the line, to the plant manager's tablet, to the CEO's phone — everyone sees one version of the truth.
production_dash.cap3_body: Your products, machines, and production stages are unique. The dashboard is designed around your real production map — not a generic template.
production_dash.views_title: Six Angles on Your Production Line
production_dash.views_body: From the macro plant view down to a single machine or operator — every operational question has a dedicated view.
production_dash.view1_body: Today's production vs. plan, active shift, target attainment, and the critical spots — all on one management page.
production_dash.view2_body: The global standard for production: availability × performance × quality, in a single number comparable across lines and shifts.
production_dash.view3_body: Root-cause analysis of planned and unplanned downtime; identify the top five causes and the hidden cost of each.
production_dash.view4_body: Scrap rate, primary root causes, and distribution across machines and operators; lower scrap with data-backed decisions.
production_dash.view5_body: Per-operator and per-shift performance at the line level; spot top performers and surface real training needs.
production_dash.view6_body: Annual and monthly production trend, nameplate-capacity utilization, and remaining headroom — input for investment and expansion decisions.
production_dash.kpis_body: Metrics that — in Vitray's manufacturing projects — have proven to drive the most impact on plant leadership decisions. All fully customizable.
production_dash.stack_title: Built on a Professional Data Stack
production_dash.stack_body: Line data is extracted with SSIS from MES, PLCs, and ERP, modeled in an independent Semantic Layer on SSAS Tabular, and finally turned into a fast, real-time Power BI dashboard.
production_dash.demo_body: A real Power BI sample built by the Vitray team — filter, drill down, and explore the data yourself right now.

maintenance_dash.hero_body: From failure history and PM compliance to repair cost and asset health — Vitray's Maintenance Dashboard takes you from reacting to breakdowns to proactively managing your asset fleet.
maintenance_dash.caps_title: What the Maintenance Dashboard Gives You
maintenance_dash.caps_body: Three core pillars that set Vitray's maintenance dashboard apart for maintenance leaders.
maintenance_dash.cap1_body: From CMMS and work-order software to PLC condition data and downtime log files — all your asset data flows into one unified place.
maintenance_dash.cap2_body: Technician next to the machine, maintenance supervisor in the office, plant manager on the go — everyone sees one version of the truth, with role-based access control.
maintenance_dash.cap3_body: Your machines, maintenance cycles, and procedures are unique. The dashboard is designed around the real structure of your assets — not a generic template.
maintenance_dash.views_body: From the macro uptime view to deep single-failure analysis — every maintenance question has a dedicated view.
maintenance_dash.view1_body: Fleet uptime, number of open work orders, active failures, and at-risk assets — all on one management page.
maintenance_dash.view2_body: On-schedule PM completion rate, overdue items, and PM-to-CM ratio; a measure of how mature your shift from reactive to proactive really is.
maintenance_dash.view3_body: Root-cause analysis of failures, per-asset failure frequency, and recurring patterns — to eliminate problems at the source.
maintenance_dash.view4_body: Mean time to repair and mean time between failures for each asset; two global-standard metrics for fleet health.
maintenance_dash.view5_body: Maintenance cost per asset, breakdown between parts and labor, and the assets whose maintenance cost has crossed the economic threshold.
maintenance_dash.view6_body: Assets classified by production impact and failure frequency, so maintenance resources concentrate on the equipment that matters most.
maintenance_dash.kpis_body: Metrics that — in Vitray's maintenance projects — have proven to drive the most impact on maintenance leadership decisions. All fully customizable.
maintenance_dash.stack_title: Built on a Professional Data Stack
maintenance_dash.stack_body: CMMS and condition-monitoring data is extracted with SSIS, modeled in an independent Semantic Layer on SSAS Tabular, and finally turned into a fast, trustworthy Power BI dashboard.

warehouse_dash.hero_body: From days of inventory and turnover to capital locked in stock and dead inventory — Vitray's Warehouse Dashboard helps you free up working capital without missing sales opportunities.
warehouse_dash.caps_title: What the Warehouse Dashboard Gives You
warehouse_dash.caps_body: Three core pillars that set Vitray's warehouse dashboard apart for warehouse and supply-chain leaders.
warehouse_dash.cap1_body: From WMS and ERP to Excel files tracking inbound and outbound flow — all your inventory and movement data flows into one unified place.
warehouse_dash.cap2_body: Warehouse supervisor on mobile, supply-chain manager on laptop, CEO on the go — everyone sees one version of the truth.
warehouse_dash.cap3_body: Your item groups, sub-warehouses, and workflows are unique. The dashboard is designed around the real structure of your warehouses — not a generic template.
warehouse_dash.views_title: Six Angles on Inventory and Working Capital
warehouse_dash.views_body: From the macro management view down to a single SKU — every warehouse question has a dedicated view.
warehouse_dash.view1_body: Core warehouse KPIs with immediate deviation detection; inventory value, turnover, locked capital, and dead stock — all in one glance.
warehouse_dash.view2_body: How many days of sales does today's stock support without replenishment? An essential metric for avoiding stockouts and over-ordering.
warehouse_dash.view3_body: Turnover rate of each item across a chosen period; identify fast movers and items locking up your capital.
warehouse_dash.view4_body: Every SKU is classified by movement velocity into three buckets — the primary tool for ordering-reduction and dead-stock-clearance decisions.
warehouse_dash.view5_body: Capital tied up in inventory calculated on current pricing — not average cost — for a real economic decision basis.
warehouse_dash.view6_body: Open and overdue purchase requests by department; full control over the procurement cycle.
warehouse_dash.kpis_body: Metrics that — in Vitray's warehouse projects — have proven to drive the most impact on supply-chain leadership decisions. All fully customizable.
warehouse_dash.stack_title: Built on a Professional Data Stack
warehouse_dash.stack_body: Warehouse data is extracted with SSIS from WMS, ERP, and branch files, modeled in an independent Semantic Layer on SSAS Tabular, and finally turned into a fast, polished Power BI dashboard.
warehouse_dash.demo_body: A real Power BI sample built by the Vitray team — filter, drill down, and explore the data yourself right now.

pbi_download.hero_body: Official Microsoft tools for building enterprise business intelligence — from Power BI and SQL Server to Visual Studio extensions, all in one place and ready to download.
pbi_download.pbi_title: Download Power BI & Power BI Report Server — May 2026
pbi_download.pbi_body: Power BI is Microsoft's business intelligence and data visualization tool. It lets you design outstanding management dashboards at remarkable speed. These dashboards amplify the impact of your data and let you monitor it on any device — desktop, laptop, tablet, or phone.
pbi_download.pbidesktop_caption: Desktop edition compatible with Report Server
pbi_download.vs_body: At Vitray we follow the Enterprise BI method. After deploying SQL Server Analysis Services, every user — based on their access level and security — can build the dashboards and reports they need with either Excel or Power BI, without any technical knowledge.
pbi_download.note: Vitray delivers business intelligence solutions using Microsoft tools — SSIS, SSAS, and Power BI.
